rationale: 034 marked window_decorations already_matched because 028 TitleBar always had min/max/close. That ignored TITLE vs INTEGRATED_BUTTONS vs RESIZE/NONE. Map lua flags to WindowOptions (native caption vs appears_transparent, is_resizable) and paint: native TITLE has no GPUI TitleBar; INTEGRATED_BUTTONS puts TabBar inside TitleBar; RESIZE/NONE have no window buttons. Left alignment / custom button list / macOS flags stay parked. Do not start 026.
